Subject: Post-demo: Nimbus interop lab scope & AB test schedule

Hi Lena — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared lab plan: 

Summary from our side:
- Goal: validate Redwood vs. your current inference setup (Hyperscaler API + in-house endpoint) on latency (p95/p99) and throughput (tokens/sec) for the 3 canonical workloads you showed.
- Success metrics: p95 within 20% of their baseline for the long-context model, p99 within 2x, and tokens/sec throughput improvements for batching scenarios.

Proposed tests (short):
1) A/B head-to-head: Redwood-hosted model variant vs Hyperscaler API (same model size/config). 1k requests/sample, measure p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec.
2) Dedicated throughput sweep: vary concurrency and batch sizes (1, 4, 8, 16) to build tokens/sec curve.
3) KV-cache/prefix warmup check: short prompt vs warmed cache to see incremental latency benefits.

What we need from Nimbus:
- One representative dataset (anonymized) for each workload (small sample ok).
- A staging API key or temporary test account (ops+benchmark@nimbus.com is fine) or network instructions if you want tests run from inside your VPC.
- Any rate limits or length caps to respect.

Attached: nimbus-inference-test-specs.csv (input schema + sampling guidance) and p95-p99-sample-results-template.xlsx (for results).

Proposed timing: kickoff early next week (Mon/Tue). If you want Redwood to run the tests from within Nimbus VPC we’ll need brief access/setup time — otherwise we can run from Redwood-hosted and provide replayable workloads.

Next step: can you confirm ops+benchmark@nimbus.com as the run owner and whether you prefer in-VPC or Redwood-hosted execution?

Thanks — I’ll pull together a concrete AB matrix after your reply.

—

- For the Hyperscaler comparison, our baseline currently uses "HyperCloud API v2" with model config hyper-llama-13b/q4. Please include that exact config in the spec.

AB matrix (draft):
- Variant A: Redwood-hosted, model = redwood-13b-fp16, batching = adaptive, contexts = {512, 2048, 4096}, samples = 1000 per context
- Variant B: Hyperscaler API (hyper-llama-13b/q4), default batching, same contexts, samples = 1000
- Variant C: Redwood in-VPC runner (if provided) using redwood-13b-quant, fixed batch sizes {4,8,16}

Metrics to collect: p50/p90/p95/p99, mean tokens/sec, percentile latency by token position, memory footprints (if in-vpc).

Responsibilities:
